text:
Assistant A provides a correct standard divide-and-conquer approach for finding the median of two sorted arrays, including handling odd/even total lengths and different array sizes. Its complexity claims are not fully accurate because slicing creates extra copies, so it is not truly O(1) space, but the algorithm is still substantially correct. Assistant B’s code is not a valid median-finding algorithm: it does not handle even-length cases, does not correctly compute the median, and its loop logic is flawed. Therefore, Assistant A is clearly better.

[[A]]
